links.targetTitle: Osero's relationship with Sky rests on a bilateral Ecosystem

title: Ecosystem Accords make Agent-to-Agent agreements a first-class artifact, so coordination between Agents is contractual rather than hierarchical
content:
A.6.1.1.2.3.5 states that "Grove has formally agreed to the Ecosystem Accords herein," then lists three: Accord 1 with the Spark Agent (A.2.8.2.1), Accord 2 with "Sky, Moonbow and the Spark Agent" (A.2.8.2.2, the Prime Program), and Accord 10 with Sky (A.2.8.2.10).

The structure is what makes this notable. Accords live at their own addresses in the shared A.2.8.2 range, not inside any one participant's Artifact, and each participating Agent references the Accord from its own document. The agreement is a single object with multiple signatories rather than matching clauses maintained separately — so it cannot be amended by one party editing their own Artifact.

That implies a coordination model that is not purely hierarchical. Agents could in principle be coordinated entirely from above, with the Atlas assigning each a Scope and resolving conflicts by rule. Accords add a horizontal channel: Agents negotiate terms with each other and register the result. Accord 1 being bilateral between two Agents, with no Sky party, shows the channel is genuinely peer-to-peer.

The Accords also carry real operational weight rather than being declarations of intent. A.6.1.1.2.3.4.2.2 places the transfer of Lite PSM management under Ecosystem Accord 2 — an Accord is the instrument by which control of live peg infrastructure moves between parties.

The numbering is the other tell. Grove holds Accords 1, 2 and 10 out of a series, so the ecosystem maintains a shared register in which Grove participates in three. Reading any single Agent's Artifact therefore understates the agreements binding it: the obligations are real but the text lives elsewhere, and only the reference is local.
description: Grove records three Accords — bilateral with Spark, multilateral with Sky, Moonbow and Spark, and bilateral with Sky — each held at its own Atlas address and referenced from the Agent's own Artifact.
